description: This Java interface defines a service related to retrieving loan IDs and COB (Close Of Business) partitions in a loan management or banking system, likely part of a batch processing or COB (Close of Business) processing module.

classes.name: RetrieveLoanIdService
classes.description: A service interface for retrieving various loan and COB partition details related to loans, used in COB processing workflows.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCOBPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves COB partitions for loans based on the number of days, business date, catch-up flag, and partition size.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDate
methods.description: Gets loan IDs that are behind a specific business date.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsBehindDateOrNull
methods.description: Gets loan IDs behind a specific date or null if none are found.

methods.name: retrieveLoanIdsOldestCobProcessed
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest COB processed loan IDs for a given business date.

methods.name: retrieveAllNonClosedLoansByLastClosedBusinessDateAndMinAndMaxLoanId
methods.description: Returns a list of non-closed loan IDs filtered by a COB parameter and catch-up status.

methods.name: findAllStayedLockedByCobBusinessDate
methods.description: Finds all loans that remained locked for a specified COB business date.
